Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We're ready to move from discovery to a technical deep-dive so your team can see our current self-hosted setup and advise on the migration approach to Redwood Dedicated. We have two engineers available next week and would like the session to cover: current inference topology, network egress constraints, auth/KMS expectations, and a preliminary runbook for cutover.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue May 11, 10:00–11:30
- Wed May 12, 10:00–11:30

Let me know which works and who from Redwood should attend. I'm including a current network diagram for context.

Thanks,

Can you confirm whether the environment has a NATed egress IP range (we'll need it for firewall whitelisting) and whether any test API credentials exist or if we'll need a short-lived read-only key?

- Karthik Iyer (Infrastructure) — will cover migration patterns and runbook
- Rishi Malhotra (Platform SWE) — will look at perf/kv-cache implications

Cheers,
